Previous cycles: ECRS cleared near-zero when cap-out was 7,000-7,700 MW. At 9,056 MW, expect material step-up. P50 estimate: $15/MWh ECRS × 76 MW = $1,140/h. This is the primary incremental advantage of 08/12 vs 08/11 at the duck floor.
